Name: Pride Flags
Author: xMarsMission
Description:
[center][PRIDE FLAGS]
by xMarsMission
[/center]Simple mod that changes the "Calico Falls" painting in-game to the LGBT pride flags.

[center][From the README.txt included with the download:][/center]
- Only use ONE (1) version unless you can and want to put these together yourself.

- Not compatible with other furniture XNB mods. I probably won't make it compatible; feel free to do so yourself and share files with these flags but please give credit and link back to the Nexus page if you use them! For reference, the painting "Calico Falls" has been replaced.

- I will not be adding any other flags or versions of existing flags. There likely won't be any updates unless I want to tweak the appearances.

[INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS]

- From ONE (1) version folder, EITHER Lesbian, Gay, Bi, or Trans, copy the "Content" folder to your Stardew Valley Directory, where Stardew Valley.exe is.

- Allow my file to overwrite the original Furniture.xnb.

[OR, FOR XNB LOADER]

- From the "Content" folder of ONE (1) version folder, EITHER Lesbian, Gay, Bi, or Trans, copy the "TileSheets" folder to XnbLoader's "ModContent" folder, so that Furniture.xnb goes into "ModContent"'s folder titled "TileSheets".



Thanks for downloading! Enjoy!
- bri

[center][Extra Info]
[/center]The hat my farmer is wearing in the screenshots was not made by me. Find it at "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1314/]gotama's Scarecrow and Hats MOD[/url]".
